about Nona

Nona is a little studio in Bandung that sews kebaya for girls who like their traditions soft, a bit dreamy, and very wearable. Every piece starts as a sketch, becomes voile and cutwork lace, and ends up at your wedding, your graduation, or tea with friends.

We pair each kebaya with batik jarik from local makers, so the whole look feels like yours. Chat with us for custom fit and wedding orders.
